title: Mexico Arrests “R2,” Alleged Leader of “Los Rs” Linked to the Murder of Carlos Manzo; He Was Wounded in a Clash.
author: Iván Evair Saldaña and César Arellano
content:
_This article by[Iván Evair Saldaña and César
Arellano](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Iv%C3%A1n%20Evair%20Salda%C3%B1a%20y%20C%C3%A9sar%20Arellano)
originally appeared in the [November 8, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/08/politica/detienen-
al-r2-presunto-lider-de-los-rs-y-a-otros-19-resulto-herido-en-enfrentamiento),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The Secretariat of the Navy reported that members of the
Naval Special Operations Unit (UNOPES) arrested on Sunday in Zapopan, Jalisco,
Rafael "N," alias "R2," **alleged leader of "Los Rs," a cell of the Jalisco
New Generation Cartel (CJNG)**, who is linked to the murder of the mayor of
Uruapan, Carlos Manzo.

Through social media, it detailed that during the operation, in which **19
other people were arrested** , there was an armed clash that left "R2" and a
Navy member wounded.

"They are receiving medical attention. The situation is under control," the
Secretariat said.

The Secretariat of Security and Citizen Protection (SSPC) and the Mexican Army
took part in the operation, with intelligence work from the National
Intelligence Center (CNI) and the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA).

The head of the SSPC, Omar García Harfuch, said the alleged criminal is
**wanted for extradition by the United States** and has an arrest warrant for
homicide in Michoacán. In addition, he said the criminal cell he leads is also
linked to homicides, drug trafficking, attacks on authorities and extortion,
mainly of avocado growers.

On the state of health of "R2," García Harfuch said he is already "receiving
medical attention," without further detail.

"The information is preliminary and will be updated as the investigations
progress," he concluded.
